title: The Future of Open Human Feedback

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation and categorization of existing human feedback datasets (e.g., PRISM, Chatbot Arena, InstructGPT) based on the openness and diversity of their human participation, contrasting diverse public annotator pools against narrow cohorts of hired contractors.

Literature review and theoretical framework analyzing the demographic, geographic, and linguistic homogeneity in current LLM feedback datasets, proposing community-led peer production ecosystems to mitigate these representation gaps.
